items.title: Namibia paves way for phosphate mining in the Atlantic Ocean
items.summary: Namibia has granted environmental clearance for an offshore phosphate mining project that paves the way for the world's first commercial seabed-dredging operation for the mineral, despite opposition from green groups and the fishing industry.

items.title: Tides can vary by almost a meter across a single bay, four decades of satellite images reveal
items.summary: Tide levels can vary by almost a meter across a single bay, according to a new study that uses decades of satellite images to measure tides at the scale of individual beaches.

items.title: Bright ideas accelerate the hunt for quantum emitters
items.summary: The search for materials that can power future quantum technologies is accelerating, but identifying the most promising candidates remains painfully slow. items.title: Tens of thousands flee fire near U.S. city of Reno
items.summary: Tens of thousands of people looked set to spend another night away from home Monday as a wind-driven fire bore down on the western U.S. city of Reno.

items.title: Scientists find hidden “highways” guiding animal evolution

items.title: Trees 'giving up': Climate change hammers historic English gardens
items.summary: At Hampton Court Palace, head gardener Graham Dillamore strode across the burned beige grass in the spectacular formal gardens southwest of London, laid out in the 17th century.

items.title: Govorio je da je "Bog mrtav", prigrlili su ga nacisti. I danas je kontroverzan
items.summary: FRIEDRICH Nietzsche, utjecajan filozof, svojim je idejama i dalje predmet rasprava i krivih tumačenja, unatoč preziranju antisemitizma i nacionalizma.

items.title: NASA finds Earth microbes could survive on the Moon
items.summary: NASA scientists found that microbes brought by astronauts could survive in cold, shadowed niches around the Moon’s South Pole, potentially complicating future searches for pristine lunar chemistry.
